positive_findings: The primary objective remains Agent construction and optimization of a complete task-specific inference engine; validation and records support that objective.
C01-C12 describe deployment/model/workload conditions; U01-U07 describe the current engineering decision. They are different coordinates, not competing task definitions.
The added design-synthesis H2 is a navigation/decision bridge; it does not prescribe one architecture or force reconstruction for an already working implementation.

The template keeps mechanism derivation, math and natural topic structure. It adds decision/contract/experiment questions without imposing uniform short cards or unnecessary alternatives to fixed mathematics.
Knowledge reading, declared use, engineering adherence, task outcome and cross-task support are explicitly separated.
The prose and JSON disclaim automatic routing, task-scope inference and workflow execution; existing search/read/version-record abilities have static source support.
The seven JSON cases match both prose tables and their principal chapter links. Additional JSON roles are consistent with the prose paragraph assigning Experimenter/Evolution supporting work.
limits: No repository prose, catalog, navigation or runtime source was edited by this reviewer.
No new literature review or audit of unchanged source attributions; no revalidation of the original twelve scenario arithmetic.
Static runtime source evidence does not establish the results of the separate current-content runtime probe, nor any historical publication/recovery regression.
Catalog revisions, frozen-view generation, index coverage and navigation structure are left to root integration and its separate checks.
No Agent, model, GPU, service or performance experiment was run. Passing this review is not evidence of engine delivery, performance gain, knowledge causal benefit or research novelty.
Conclusion applies only to the listed final file hashes; later edits require review of their changed scope.
